subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive — confirm time, attendees, and meeting link
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@heliocare.com>, Karen Cho <karen.cho@heliocare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed deep-dive slots

Hi Alex / Karen —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- HelioCare is focused on reducing inference latency for clinical notes extraction and lowering per-token cost for nightly batch jobs.
- Security and data residency are blockers for your SOC 2 sprint; procurement also wants a short SOW-like timeline.
- Key technical goals: sub-150ms p95 for short prompts, predictable throughput for scheduled batches, and audit logs retained 90 days.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep-dive where Karthik walks your engineers through runtime tradeoffs, network/VPC options, and a short quantization demo. Please confirm who from your side will join (engineering, security, procurement).

Available slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 17, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 18, 13:00–14:00 PT (preferred for our EMEA folks)
- Thu Aug 19, 08:00–09:00 PT (early slot)

Do you have a preference and which meeting platform do you prefer (Zoom or Google Meet)? I attached a draft agenda and a one-page mutual action plan to speed alignment. Once you confirm a slot I’ll send the calendar invite + bridge and include an internal pre-call with our security engineer if you want.

Agenda (short):
- 5m intro / success criteria
- 20m infra & routing + VPC/KMS options (Karthik)
- 15m runtime demo (quantization/batching)
- 10m integration checklist and MAP review
- 10m Q&A / next steps

Attachments: RI-DeepDive-Agenda.pdf, Mutual-Action-Plan.docx

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Rivera <alex@heliocare.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Cho <karen.cho@heliocare.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed deep-dive slots

Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. Wed Aug 18, 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our engineers.

Please include our security lead, Samir Patel (samir.patel@heliocare.com) and procurement on the invite — Samir will want to see the KMS/HSM options and a short note on audit logs. Procurement (procurement@heliocare.com) will most likely be a passive attendee but would like the MAP and a ballpark of committed throughput for the SOW.

We prefer Zoom for external bridges; can you include a dial-in option? Also please add a 20-min pre-call with Samir at 12:30 PT on Aug 18 to walk security specifics.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Engineering, HelioCare
